sentences.text: Today at twelve thirty Pacific, the Barry Morphew case is back in court.
She was forty-nine when she went missing on Mother's Day, May tenth, twenty twenty.
Her remains were found in twenty twenty-three.
Her husband, Barry Morphew, is charged with first-degree murder in her death.
By law, he is presumed innocent.
An earlier case against him was dismissed in twenty twenty-two.
Today is a status conference, held by video.
It is a check-in on the schedule. It is not a trial.
No verdict can come from it.
News reports say his trial is planned for summer twenty twenty-seven.
Court dates and sources: Cassy-an Creed dot com.
